"""Vision/force feedback insertion controller; no recorded trajectories."""
import re,sys,workcell

def do(tool,*args,required=True):
    r=workcell.call(tool,*args)
    print(tool,' '.join(map(str,args)), '=>',r.text,flush=True)
    if required and not r.ok: raise RuntimeError(r.text)
    return r

def measure():
    s=do('vision','locate').text
    hole=re.search(r'socket hole centre: x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+).*?top at z=([-\d.]+)',s)
    peg=re.search(r'peg: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+) mm; lower end x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+) mm; tilt ([-\d.]+)',s)
    if not (hole and peg): raise RuntimeError('Vision unavailable')
    return list(map(float,hole.groups())),list(map(float,peg.groups()))

def step(dx,dy,dz):
    r=do('robot','step','right',round(dx,1),round(dy,1),round(dz,1),required=False)
    if 'force exceeds 25' in r.text.lower(): raise RuntimeError('force limit')
    return r

def run():
    do('trial','start')
    do('robot','pick','cap','--arm','left')
    do('robot','place','bin','--arm','left')
    hole,peg=measure()
    # Rough gripper-frame offset on this uncalibrated arm; vision verifies the actual grasp.
    x,y=peg[0]-2.4,peg[1]-1
    do('robot','move','right',round(x,1),round(y,1),103)
    do('robot','move','right',round(x,1),round(y,1),round(peg[2]+6,1))
    do('robot','grip','right','close')
    do('robot','move','right',round(peg[0]),round(peg[1]),160)
    _,lift=measure()
    if lift[5]<95: raise RuntimeError('Grasp not verified: peg not lifted')
    do('robot','move','right',hole[0],hole[1],122)
    hole,p=measure()
    # Align observed lower end (rather than encoder TCP) at clearance height.
    step(max(-8,min(8,hole[0]-p[3])),max(-8,min(8,hole[1]-p[4])),0)
    # Lower in small increments; react to measured hole alignment and force.
    for n in range(12):
        hole,p=measure()
        print('approach',n,'tip',p[3:6], 'tilt',p[6],flush=True)
        if p[5]<=26: break
        # Close to the hole, very modest lateral corrections to avoid wedging.
        dx=max(-1.5,min(1.5,hole[0]-p[3])) if p[5]<59 else 0
        dy=max(-1.5,min(1.5,hole[1]-p[4])) if p[5]<59 else 0
        dz=-min(10,max(2,p[5]-24))
        step(dx,dy,dz)
    else: raise RuntimeError('Insertion did not reach release depth')
    # Once the tip is captive in the hole, release to remove grasp-induced tilt;
    # gravity seats the peg and vision checks the bottom is at full insertion depth.
    do('robot','grip','right','open')
    do('robot','move','right',hole[0],hole[1],160)
    hole,p=measure()
    if p[5]>17 or p[6]>3: raise RuntimeError('Not seated after release: '+str(p))
    do('trial','end')

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:run()
    except Exception as e:
        print('CONTROLLER STOP:',e,flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)

"""Vision/force feedback insertion controller; no recorded trajectories."""
import re,sys,workcell

def do(tool,*args,required=True):
    r=workcell.call(tool,*args)
    print(tool,' '.join(map(str,args)), '=>',r.text,flush=True)
    if required and not r.ok: raise RuntimeError(r.text)
    return r

def measure():
    s=do('vision','locate').text
    hole=re.search(r'socket hole centre: x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+).*?top at z=([-\d.]+)',s)
    peg=re.search(r'peg: centre x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+) mm; lower end x=([-\d.]+) y=([-\d.]+) z=([-\d.]+) mm; tilt ([-\d.]+)',s)
    if not (hole and peg): raise RuntimeError('Vision unavailable')
    return list(map(float,hole.groups())),list(map(float,peg.groups()))

def step(dx,dy,dz):
    r=do('robot','step','right',round(dx,1),round(dy,1),round(dz,1),required=False)
    if 'force exceeds 25' in r.text.lower(): raise RuntimeError('force limit')
    return r

def run():
    do('trial','start')
    do('robot','pick','cap','--arm','left')
    do('robot','place','bin','--arm','left')
    hole,peg=measure()
    # Rough gripper-frame offset on this uncalibrated arm; vision verifies the actual grasp.
    x,y=peg[0]-2.4,peg[1]-1
    do('robot','move','right',round(x,1),round(y,1),103)
    do('robot','move','right',round(x,1),round(y,1),round(peg[2]+6,1))
    do('robot','grip','right','close')
    do('robot','move','right',round(peg[0]),round(peg[1]),160)
    _,lift=measure()
    if lift[5]<95: raise RuntimeError('Grasp not verified: peg not lifted')
    do('robot','move','right',hole[0],hole[1],122)
    hole,p=measure()
    # Align observed lower end (rather than encoder TCP) at clearance height.
    step(max(-8,min(8,hole[0]-p[3])),max(-8,min(8,hole[1]-p[4])),0)
    # Lower in small increments; react to measured hole alignment and force.
    for n in range(12):
        hole,p=measure()
        print('approach',n,'tip',p[3:6], 'tilt',p[6],flush=True)
        if p[5]<=26: break
        # Close to the hole, very modest lateral corrections to avoid wedging.
        dx=max(-1.5,min(1.5,hole[0]-p[3])) if p[5]<59 else 0
        dy=max(-1.5,min(1.5,hole[1]-p[4])) if p[5]<59 else 0
        dz=-min(10,max(2,p[5]-24))
        step(dx,dy,dz)
    else: raise RuntimeError('Insertion did not reach release depth')
    # Once the tip is captive in the hole, release to remove grasp-induced tilt;
    # gravity seats the peg and vision checks the bottom is at full insertion depth.
    do('robot','grip','right','open')
    do('robot','move','right',hole[0],hole[1],160)
    hole,p=measure()
    if p[5]>17 or p[6]>3: raise RuntimeError('Not seated after release: '+str(p))
    do('trial','end')

if __name__=='__main__':
    try:run()
    except Exception as e:
        print('CONTROLLER STOP:',e,flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
